reason: Token source of truth: the only place color values are defined.
Studio backdrop cyclorama gradient stops (STUDIO_STOPS): viewport art per backdrop mode, not UI theme.
environmentBackdrop clear colors: viewport backdrop coupled to stage, not UI.
SpotLight color: render-internal lighting, not UI.
ColorPicker gradients and white handles: functional color-space rendering, not themeable.
ColorPicker black-to-transparent gradient stop: functional color-space rendering.
Compare slider handle and render-overlay chips: must contrast with arbitrary render pixels in every theme.
CSS mask alpha stops: coverage, not visible color.
